texts.facts: 2. This is an application for bail in respect of the offence punishable under Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code (hereafter 'Ipc' for short) and under Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 registered on 01.09.2023 vide C.R. No.71 of 2023 with Sindhudurgnagari Police Station, District Sindhudurg. The applicant was arrested on 01.09.2023. Rest of the offences are bailable. 4. Learned APP opposed the application for bail contending that the charge-sheet is likely to be filed soon and that the applicant can apply for bail after the charge- sheet is filed. Learned APP submitted that there are as many as four offences of similar nature registered against the present applicant. The main accused - Bhushan Shrikrishna Shirsat has been granted interim protection by this Court in Anticipatory Bail Application No.2792 of 2023 that is filed by him.
